main_text.p: differit, ac prædicit eorū hac in parte peccata, nempe fiduciam in externa auxilia, & contemptum Diuinarum admonitionum, haud fore impunita. Haud dubie his rationibus primò declarare vult, certissimas esse & diuinitùs acceptas suas prædictiones: secundò admonere, ut toto corde ad Deum se conuerterent, agerentq; pœnitentia, atq; ab uno Deo opem expectarent.

Sic igitur cōtra eos qui magis respiciebant in munitiones, quàm in ipsum Deum: Respexistiq; in die illa ad armaturā, &c. Valde artificiosè describit incredulos confultantes, quomodo se aduersus hostem defendant. De domo saltus prope Libanum, atq; armis in ea repositis, 2. Paralip. 9. licet hic de alia simili domo in uel prope Ierusalem sermo accipiendus uideatur, qualem à Dauide extructam nonnulli autumant. Ciuitas Dauid eadem quæ Arx Zion, urbi coniuncta & ualde munita: 2. Samuel. [?]5. Ad huius rimas et fenestellas, per quas iaculari in hostem possent, respiciebant, easq; magni præsidij loco æstimabant. Duas item numerat piscinas, inferiorem & superiorem: atq; illius aquas dicit esse collectas, ne uidelicet arte ulla deriuari alio per hostes possent: alterius uero aquas deductas fossa inter duos muros, ut nimirum duplicatis hoc pacto muris, atq; aquis mediis, hosti undiq; additus præcluderetur. Domus numeratur, ut ad sumptus necessaria colligi, de annona constituì, uicissitudinariæ excubiæ ordinari commodius queant. Domus contiguæ muris diruūtur, ad uallum circumducendum, machinas

page.notes: The page is a single column. The reference "2.Paralip.9." stands inline at the end of a line and is transcribed in the text. "2. Samuel. 5" is partly doubtful: the final numeral is read as 5 [?]. Words broken across lines were joined without hyphen where no printed hyphen was clear (confultantes, duplicatis, additus, munitiones, Diuinarum, admonere). Long s was normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised as per the rules. The line "machinas" carries on from the previous paragraph and is the last full line; "bellicas" is the catchword.
